newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Lernout & Hauspie to list on Easdaq Jun 23.
newsitem.headline: Lernout & Hauspie to list on Easdaq Jun 23.

text.p: regulatory announcement on Friday. ANNOUNCEMENT LERNOUT &
HAUSPIE SPEECH PRODUCTS N.V. Sint-Krispijnstraat, 7 B - 8900
Ieper Belgium The EASDAQ Market Authority has approved an
application for admission to trading on EASDAQ of all Common
Stock of LERNOUT & HAUSPIE Speech Products N.V.

admission to trading on EASDAQ relates to all Common Stock currently admitted to trading on NASDAQ. No shares or other securities will be issued and no offering of shares or other securities is taking place or will take place in connection with this admission. Prior to admission to trading on EASDAQ, 15,715,558 shares were admitted to trading on NASDAQ. The company's shares are expected to trade under the Reuters symbol LHSP.ED on EASDAQ from June 23,1997. This is a regulatory announcement required by the Market Authority pursuant to EASDAQ rules. This announcement is for information purposes only. It shall not constitute an offer to sell or the solicitation of an offer to buy nor shall there be any sale of these securities in any country in which suchoffer, solicitation or sale would be unlawful prior to registration or qualification under the securities laws of any such country.
